sentences.text: peter : Hello?
sentences.zh: peter : 喂？

sentences.text: jan : Oh hello.
sentences.zh: jan : 哦，你好。

sentences.text: My name's Jan.
sentences.zh: 我的名字是简。

sentences.text: Are you the right person to talk to about the Buckworth Conservation Group?
sentences.zh: 您是负责布克沃思环保小组事务的合适联系人吗？

sentences.text: peter : Yes, I'm Peter.
sentences.zh: peter : 是的，我是彼得。

sentences.text: I'm the secretary.
sentences.zh: 我担任该小组的秘书。

sentences.text: jan : Good.
sentences.zh: jan : 太好了。

sentences.text: I've just moved to this area, and I'm interested in getting involved.
sentences.zh: 我刚搬到这个地区，很想参与其中。

sentences.text: I was in a similar group where I used to live.
sentences.zh: 我以前住的地方也有一个类似的环保小组。

sentences.text: Could you tell me something about your activities, please?
sentences.zh: 您能向我介绍一下你们开展的活动吗？

sentences.text: peter : Of course.
sentences.zh: peter : 当然可以。

sentences.text: Well, we have a mixture of regular activities and special events.
sentences.zh: 我们既有常规活动，也有特别活动。

sentences.text: One of the regular ones is trying to keep the beach free of litter.
sentences.zh: 其中一项常规活动是努力保持海滩清洁、无垃圾。

sentences.text: A few of us spend a couple of hours a month on it, and it's awful how much there is to clear.
sentences.zh: 我们几个人每月花几个小时做这项工作，但要清理的垃圾数量实在令人震惊。

sentences.text: I wish people would be more responsible and take it home with them.
sentences.zh: 我希望人们能更有责任感，把垃圾带回家处理。

sentences.text: jan : I totally agree.
sentences.zh: jan : 我完全同意。

sentences.text: I'd be happy to help with that.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意帮忙做这件事。

sentences.text: Is it OK to take dogs?
sentences.zh: 可以带狗去吗？

sentences.text: peter : I'm afraid not, as they're banned from the beach itself.
sentences.zh: peter : 很抱歉，不行，因为海滩本身是禁止携犬进入的。

sentences.text: You can take them along the cliffs, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，您可以带狗沿着悬崖散步。

sentences.text: And children are welcome.
sentences.zh: 儿童也欢迎参加。

sentences.text: jan : Right.
sentences.zh: jan : 明白了。

sentences.text: peter : We also manage a nature reserve, and there's a lot to do there all year round.
sentences.zh: peter : 我们还管理着一处自然保护区，全年都有大量工作要做。

sentences.text: For example, because it's a popular place to visit, we spend a lot of time looking after the paths and making sure they're in good condition for walking.
sentences.zh: 例如，由于这里是一个热门游览地，我们花大量时间维护步道，并确保它们处于良好的步行状态。

sentences.text: jan : I could certainly help with that.
sentences.zh: jan : 这项工作我 certainly 可以帮忙。

sentences.text: peter : Good.
sentences.zh: peter : 很好。

sentences.text: And we have a programme of creating new habitats there.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们还在那里实施一项新建栖息地的计划。

sentences.text: We've just finished making and installing nesting boxes for birds to use, and next we're going to work on encouraging insects – they're important for the biodiversity of the reserve.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚完成并安装了一批供鸟类使用的巢箱；接下来我们将致力于吸引昆虫——它们对保护区的生物多样性至关重要。

sentences.text: jan : They certainly are.
sentences.zh: jan : 的确如此。

sentences.text: peter : Oh, and we're also running a project to identify the different species of butterflies that visit the reserve.
sentences.zh: peter : 哦，另外我们还在开展一项项目，旨在识别造访该保护区的不同蝴蝶种类。

sentences.text: You might be interested in taking part in that.
sentences.zh: 您或许有兴趣参与这项工作。

sentences.text: jan : Sure.
sentences.zh: jan : 当然可以。

sentences.text: I was involved in something similar where I used to live, counting all the species of moths.
sentences.zh: 我以前住的地方就参与过类似项目，负责统计各种蛾类的种类。

sentences.text: I'd enjoy that.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意做这件事。

sentences.text: peter : Another job we're doing at the reserve is replacing the wall on the southern side, between the parking area and our woodshed.
sentences.zh: peter : 我们在保护区另一项正在进行的工作，是重建南侧围墙，即停车场与我们的木料棚之间的那段墙。

sentences.text: It was badly damaged in a storm last month.
sentences.zh: 上个月一场暴风雨严重损坏了这堵墙。

sentences.text: jan : OK.
sentences.zh: jan : 好的。

sentences.text: peter : Then as I said, we have a programme of events as well, both at the weekend, and during the week.
sentences.zh: peter : 正如我刚才所说，我们还有系列主题活动，包括周末和工作日都会举办。

sentences.text: jan : Right.
sentences.zh: jan : 明白了。

sentences.text: I presume you have guided walks?
sentences.zh: 我想你们应该有导览步行活动吧？

sentences.text: I'd like to get to know the local countryside, as I'm new to the area.
sentences.zh: 我想了解一下当地的乡村，因为我刚搬到这个地区。

sentences.text: peter : Yes, we do.
sentences.zh: peter: 是的，我们有。

sentences.text: The next walk is to Ruston Island, a week on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 下一次徒步是去拉斯顿岛，下周六。

sentences.text: We'll be meeting in the car park at Dunsmore Beach at low tide – that's when the sands are dry enough for us to walk to the island without getting wet.
sentences.zh: 我们将在邓斯莫尔海滩的停车场集合，时间是退潮时——那时沙滩足够干燥，我们可以步行到岛上而不会弄湿鞋子。

sentences.text: jan : Sounds good.
sentences.zh: jan: 听起来不错。

sentences.text: 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129
sentences.zh: 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129

sentences.text: So, hello everyone.
sentences.zh: 那么，大家好。

sentences.text: My name's Lou Miller and I'm going to be your tour guide today as we take this fantastic boat trip around the Tasmanian coast.
sentences.zh: 我叫露·米勒，今天将担任你们的导游，带大家乘坐这艘精彩的游船环游塔斯马尼亚海岸。

sentences.text: Before we set off, I just want to tell you a few things about our journey.
sentences.zh: 在出发之前，我想先向大家简要介绍一下本次行程。

sentences.text: Our boats aren't huge as you can see.
sentences.zh: 我们的船并不大，大家可以看到。

sentences.text: We already have three staff members on board and on top of that, we can transport a further fifteen people – that' s you – around the coastline.
sentences.zh: 船上已有三名工作人员，此外还可搭载十五名乘客——也就是各位——沿海岸线游览。

sentences.text: But please note if there are more than nine people on either side of the boat, we'll move some of you over, otherwise all eighteen of us will end up in the sea!
sentences.zh: 但请注意：如果船体任一侧人数超过九人，我们将安排部分乘客换到另一侧，否则我们十八个人都会掉进海里！

sentences.text: We've recently upgraded all our boats.
sentences.zh: 我们最近对所有船只进行了升级。

sentences.text: They used to be jet black, but our new ones now have these comfortable dark red seats and a light-green exterior in order to stand out from others and help promote our company.
sentences.zh: 以前的船是喷漆成纯黑色的，而新船则配备了舒适的深红色座椅，并采用浅绿色船体外观，以便与其他船只区分开来，并有助于推广我们的公司。

sentences.text: This gives our boats a rather unique appearance, don't you think?
sentences.zh: 这让我们的船只呈现出相当独特的外观，您不这么认为吗？

sentences.text: We offer you a free lunchbox during the trip and we have three types.
sentences.zh: 旅途中我们会为各位免费提供午餐盒，共有三种类型。

sentences.text: Lunchbox 1 contains ham and tomato sandwiches.
sentences.zh: 1号午餐盒包含火腿番茄三明治。

sentences.text: Lunchbox 2 contains a cheddar cheese roll and Lunchbox 3 is salad-based and also contains eggs and tuna.
sentences.zh: 2号午餐盒包含切达奶酪卷，3号午餐盒以沙拉为主，还含有鸡蛋和金枪鱼。

sentences.text: All three lunchboxes also have a packet of crisps and chocolate bar inside.
sentences.zh: 这三种午餐盒内均配有薯片一包和巧克力一条。

sentences.text: Please let staff know which lunchbox you prefer.
sentences.zh: 请告知工作人员您偏好的午餐盒类型。

sentences.text: I'm sure I don't have to ask you not to throw anything into the sea.
sentences.zh: 我相信我不必特别提醒大家不要向海中丢弃任何物品。

sentences.text: We don't have any bins to put litter in, but Jess, myself or Ray, our other guide, will collect it from you after lunch and put it all in a large plastic sack.
sentences.zh: 船上没有垃圾桶可投放垃圾，但杰西、我本人或另一位导游雷会在午餐后向各位收集垃圾，并统一装入一个大型塑料袋中。

sentences.text: The engine on the boat makes quite a lot of noise so before we head of f, let me tell you a few things about what you're going to see.
sentences.zh: 船用发动机噪音较大，因此在启航前，让我先为大家简要介绍一下沿途将看到的景观。

sentences.text: 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129 Audioscripts This area is famous for its ancient lighthouse, which you'll see from the boat as we turn past the first little island.
sentences.zh: 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129 听力原文 这一地区以一座古老的灯塔而闻名，当我们绕过第一座小岛时，大家可在船上看到它。

sentences.text: It was built in 1838 to protect sailors as a number of shipwrecks had led to significant loss of life .
sentences.zh: 该灯塔建于1838年，旨在保护航海者安全，因为此前多起海难已造成大量人员伤亡。

sentences.text: The construction itself was complicated as some of the original drawings kept by the local council show.
sentences.zh: 其建造过程本身十分复杂，当地议会保存的部分原始设计图纸便可证明这一点。

sentences.text: It sits right on top of the cliffs in a very isolated spot.
sentences.zh: 灯塔矗立于悬崖顶端，地处极为偏僻。

sentences.text: In the nineteenth century there were many jobs there, such as polishing the brass lamps, chopping firewood and cleaning windows, that kept lighthouse keepers busy .
sentences.zh: 十九世纪时，灯塔内有许多工作，例如擦拭黄铜灯罩、劈柴以及擦洗窗户等，这些活计让灯塔看守员始终忙碌不停。

sentences.text: These workers were mainly prison convicts until the middle of that century when ordinary families willing to live in such circumstances took over.
sentences.zh: 这些工人起初主要是囚犯，直到该世纪中叶，才由愿意在这种环境下生活的普通家庭接替。

sentences.text: Some of you have asked me what creatures we can expect to see.
sentences.zh: 你们中有些人曾问我，此行可能见到哪些动物。

sentences.text: I know everyone loves the penguins, but they're very shy and, unfortunately, tend to hide from passing boats, but you might see birds in the distance, such as sea eagles, flying around the clif f edges where they nest.
sentences.zh: 我知道大家都很喜欢企鹅，但它们非常胆小，不幸的是，通常会躲避开驶过的船只；不过，你们或许能在远处看到一些鸟类，比如白尾海雕，它们在悬崖边缘筑巢并盘旋飞翔。

sentences.text: When we get to the rocky area inhabited by fur seals, we'll stop and watch them swimming around the coast.
sentences.zh: 当我们抵达栖息着毛皮海豹的岩岸区域时，我们将停船观察它们在海岸附近游泳。

sentences.text: They're inquisitive creatures so don't be surprised if one pops up right in front of you.
sentences.zh: 这些动物好奇心很强，所以如果突然有一只海豹直接浮现在你面前，也请不必惊讶。

sentences.text: Their predators, orca whales, hunt along the coastline too, but spotting one of these is rare.
sentences.zh: 它们的天敌——逆戟鲸——也会沿着海岸线捕猎，但目击到这种动物的机会极为罕见。

sentences.text: Dolphins, on the other hand, can sometimes approach on their own or in groups as they ride the waves beside us.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，海豚有时会单独或成群主动靠近我们，伴着船边涌起的浪花游弋。

sentences.text: Lastly, I want to mention the caves.
sentences.zh: 最后，我想提一下洞穴。

sentences.text: Tasmania is famous for its caves and the ones we'll pass by are so amazing that people are lost for words when they see them.
sentences.zh: 塔斯马尼亚以洞穴闻名，而我们将途经的这些洞穴如此壮观，以至于人们初见时往往惊叹得说不出话来。

sentences.text: They can only be approached by sea, but if you feel that you want to see more than we're able to show you, then you can take a kayak into the area on another day and one of our staff will give you more information on that.
sentences.zh: 这些洞穴只能从海上接近；若您希望看到比本次行程所能展示的更多内容，可另择一日租用皮划艇进入该区域，届时我们的工作人员会为您提供更详细的资讯。

sentences.text: What we'll do is to go through a narrow channel, past some incredible rock formations and from there we'll be able to see the openings to the caves, and at that point we'll talk to you about what lies beyond.
sentences.zh: 我们的路线是穿过一条狭窄水道，经过一些令人叹为观止的岩石构造，随后即可看到洞穴入口；到达此处时，我们将向大家介绍洞穴内部的景象。

sentences.text: diana : So, Tim, we have to do a short summary of our work experience on a farm.
sentences.zh: diana: 那么，蒂姆，我们需要就农场实习经历写一份简短总结。

sentences.text: tim : Right.
sentences.zh: tim：好的。

sentences.text: My farm was great, but arranging the work experience was hard.
sentences.zh: 我的农场很棒，但安排实习工作却很难。

sentences.text: One problem was it was miles away and I don't drive.
sentences.zh: 其中一个问题是农场离我家有好几英里远，而我又不会开车。

sentences.text: And also, I'd really wanted a placement for a month, but I could only get one for two weeks.
sentences.zh: 另外，我原本特别希望能实习一个月，但最后只找到了为期两周的实习机会。

sentences.text: diana : I was lucky, the farmer let me stay on the farm so I didn't have to travel.
sentences.zh: diana：我很幸运，那位农民让我住在农场里，所以我不用每天往返奔波。

sentences.text: But finding the right sort of farm to apply to wasn't easy .
sentences.zh: 但要找到合适类型的农场去申请并不容易。

sentences.text: tim : No, they don't seem to have websites, do they.
sentences.zh: tim：是啊，他们好像都没有网站，对吧？

sentences.text: I found mine through a friend of my mother's, but it wasn't easy.
sentences.zh: 我是通过我妈妈的一个朋友才找到的，但过程也不轻松。

sentences.text: diana : No.
sentences.zh: diana：是的。

sentences.text: tim : My farm was mostly livestock, especially sheep.
sentences.zh: tim：我的农场主要饲养牲畜，尤其是绵羊。

sentences.text: I really enjoyed helping out with them.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢帮忙照看它们。

sentences.text: I was up most of one night helping a sheep deliver a lamb …
sentences.zh: 有天晚上我几乎整夜没睡，帮一只母羊接生小羊……

sentences.text: diana : On your own?
sentences.zh: diana：你一个人吗？

sentences.text: tim : No, the farmer was there, and he told me what to do.
sentences.zh: tim：不，农民也在场，他告诉我该怎么做。

sentences.text: It wasn't a straightforward birth, but I managed.
sentences.zh: 那次分娩并不顺利，但我还是成功完成了。

sentences.text: It was a great feeling to see the lamb stagger to its feet and start feeding almost straightaway, and to know that it was OK.
sentences.zh: 看到小羊摇摇晃晃地站起来、几乎立刻就开始吃奶，而且知道它一切安好，那种感觉真是太棒了。

sentences.text: diana : Mm.
sentences.zh: diana：嗯。

sentences.text: tim : Then another time a lamb had broken its leg, and they got the vet in to set it, and he talked me through what he was doing.
sentences.zh: tim：还有一次，一只小羊腿断了，他们请来了兽医为它接骨，兽医一边操作一边向我讲解整个过程。

sentences.text: That was really useful.
sentences.zh: 那真的很有帮助。

sentences.text: diana : Yes, my farm had sheep too.
sentences.zh: diana：是的，我的农场也有绵羊。

sentences.text: The farm was in a valley and they had a lowland breed called Suffolks, although the farmer said they'd had other breeds in the past.
sentences.zh: 农场位于一个山谷中，饲养的是低地品种——萨福克羊，不过那位农民说他们过去也养过其他品种。

sentences.text: tim : So were they bred for their meat?
sentences.zh: tim：那么它们主要是为了产肉而培育的吗？

sentences.text: diana : Mostly, yes .
sentences.zh: diana：基本上是的。

sentences.text: They're quite big and solid.
sentences.zh: 它们体型较大、体格健壮。

sentences.text: tim : My farm was up in the hills and they had a different breed of sheep, they were Cheviots.
sentences.zh: tim：我的农场则在山区，养的是另一种绵羊——切维厄特羊。

sentences.text: Labyrinths have existed for well over 4,000 years.
sentences.zh: 迷宫已存在了四千多年。

sentences.text: Labyrinths and labyrinthine symbols have been found in regions as diverse as modern-day Turkey, Ireland, Greece, and India.
sentences.zh: 迷宫及迷宫式符号已在土耳其、爱尔兰、希腊和印度等众多地区被发现。

sentences.text: There are various designs of labyrinth but what they all have in common is a winding spiral path which leads to a central area.
sentences.zh: 迷宫有多种设计样式，但它们共同的特点是一条蜿蜒盘旋的小径，通向中心区域。

sentences.text: There is one starting point at the entrance and the goal is to reach the central area.
sentences.zh: 入口处只有一个起点，目标就是抵达中心区域。

sentences.text: Finding your way through a labyrinth involves many twists and turns, but it's not possible to get lost as there is only one single path.
sentences.zh: 穿越迷宫需要经历许多曲折转弯，但由于只有一条路径，因此不可能迷路。

sentences.text: In modern times, the word labyrinth has taken on a different meaning and is often used as a synonym for a maze.
sentences.zh: 在现代，“迷宫”一词已衍生出不同含义，常被用作“迷阵”的同义词。

sentences.text: A maze is quite different as it is a kind of puzzle with an intricate network of paths.
sentences.zh: 迷阵则完全不同，它是一种带有复杂路径网络的谜题。

sentences.text: Mazes became fashionable in the 15th and 16th centuries in Europe, and can still be found in the gardens of great houses and palaces.
sentences.zh: 迷阵在15至16世纪的欧洲风靡一时，如今仍可见于一些宏伟宅邸和宫殿的花园中。

sentences.text: The paths are usually surrounded by thick, high hedges so that it's not possible to see over them.
sentences.zh: 这些路径通常被又高又密的树篱所包围，使人无法从上方看到路径全貌。

sentences.text: Entering a maze usually involves getting lost a few times before using logic to work out the pattern and find your way to the centre and then out again.
sentences.zh: 进入迷阵后，通常会先迷路几次，再依靠逻辑推理解析路径规律，从而找到通往中心并最终走出的路线。

sentences.text: There are lots of dead ends and paths which lead you back to where you started.
sentences.zh: 其中有许多死胡同，还有一些路径会把你带回到起点。

sentences.text: The word ‘maze' is believed to come from a Scandinavian word for a state of confusion .
sentences.zh: ‘迷阵（maze）’一词据信源自一个斯堪的纳维亚语词汇，意为‘困惑的状态’。

sentences.text: This is where the word ‘amazing' comes from.
sentences.zh: 英语单词‘令人惊叹的（amazing）’正是由此演变而来。

sentences.text: Labyrinths, on the other hand, have a very different function.
sentences.zh: 而迷宫（labyrinth）的功能则截然不同。

sentences.text: Although people now often refer to things they find complicated as labyrinths, this is not how they were seen in the past.
sentences.zh: 尽管如今人们常将自己觉得复杂的事物称为迷宫（labyrinths），但过去并非如此看待它们。

sentences.text: The winding spiral of the labyrinth has been used for centuries as a metaphor for life's journey.
sentences.zh: 迷宫的蜿蜒螺旋形数世纪以来一直被用作人生旅程的隐喻。

sentences.text: It served as a spiritual reminder that there is purpose and meaning to our lives and helped to give people a sense of direction.
sentences.zh: 它作为一种精神提醒，昭示着我们的生命具有目标与意义，并帮助人们获得方向感。

sentences.text: Labyrinths are thought to encourage a feeling of calm and have been used as a meditation and prayer tool in many cultures over many centuries.
sentences.zh: 人们认为迷宫能激发一种平静感，并在许多文化中历经多个世纪被用作冥想与祈祷的工具。

sentences.text: The earliest examples of the labyrinth spiral pattern have been found carved into stone, from Sardinia to Scandinavia, from Arizona to India to Africa.
sentences.zh: 最早期的迷宫螺旋图案实例被发现刻于石上，分布范围从撒丁岛到斯堪的纳维亚，从亚利桑那州到印度再到非洲。

sentences.text: In Europe, these spiral carvings date from the late Bronze Age.
sentences.zh: 在欧洲，这些螺旋雕刻可追溯至青铜时代晚期。

sentences.text: The Native American Pima tribe wove baskets with a circular labyrinth design that depicted their own cosmology.
sentences.zh: 美洲原住民皮马部落（Pima）编织的篮子上饰有圆形迷宫图案，用以呈现其自身的宇宙观。

sentences.text: In Ancient Greece, the labyrinth spiral was used on coins around four thousand years ago.
sentences.zh: 古希腊时期，约四千年前，迷宫螺旋图案便已用于钱币之上。

sentences.text: Labyrinths made of mosaics were commonly found in bathhouses, villas and tombs throughout the Roman Empire.
sentences.zh: 镶嵌式迷宫在罗马帝国境内普遍见于浴场、别墅及陵墓之中。

sentences.text: In Northern Europe, there were actual physical labyrinths designed for walking on.
sentences.zh: 在北欧，曾真实存在供人行走的实体迷宫。

sentences.text: These were cut into the turf or grass, usually in a circular pattern.
sentences.zh: 这些迷宫通常被切割于草皮或草坪之上，多呈圆形图案。

sentences.text: The origin of these walking labyrinths remains unclear, but they were probably used for fertility rites which may date back thousands of years.
sentences.zh: 此类步行迷宫的起源尚不明确，但它们很可能曾用于生育仪式，该传统或许可追溯至数千年前。

sentences.text: Eleven examples of turf labyrinths survive today, including the largest one at Saffron Walden, England, which used to have a large tree in the middle of it.
sentences.zh: 如今尚存十一处草皮迷宫，其中包括位于英格兰萨弗伦沃尔登（Saffron Walden）的最大一座，其正中央过去曾栽有一棵大树。

sentences.text: More recently labyrinths have experienced something of a revival.
sentences.zh: 近年来，迷宫经历了一定程度的复兴。

sentences.text: Some believe that walking a labyrinth promotes healing and mindfulness, and there are those who believe in its emotional and physical benefits, which include slower breathing and a restored sense of balance and perspective.
sentences.zh: 一些人相信，行走迷宫有助于促进疗愈与正念；另有一些人则相信迷宫具有情绪与生理层面的益处，包括呼吸变缓，以及平衡感与视角感的恢复。

sentences.text: This idea has become so popular that labyrinths have been laid into the floors of spas, wellness centres and even prisons in recent years.
sentences.zh: 这一理念已变得如此流行，以至于近年间，迷宫已被铺设于水疗中心、健康中心甚至监狱的地板之上。

sentences.text: A pamphlet at Colorado Children's Hospital informs patients that ‘walking a labyrinth can often calm people in the midst of a crisis'.
sentences.zh: 科罗拉多儿童医院（Colorado Children's Hospital）的一份宣传册告知患者：‘在危机时刻行走迷宫往往能使人心绪平静。’

sentences.text: And apparently, it's not only patients who benefit.
sentences.zh: 而且，显然受益者并不仅限于患者。

sentences.text: Many visitors find walking a labyrinth less stressful than sitting in a corridor or waiting room.
sentences.zh: 许多访客发现，相比坐在走廊或候诊室里，行走迷宫带来的压力更小。

sentences.text: Some doctors even walk the labyrinth during their breaks.
sentences.zh: 一些医生甚至会在休息时间行走迷宫。

sentences.text: In some hospitals, patients who can't walk can have a paper ‘finger labyrinth' brought to their bed.
sentences.zh: 在某些医院中，无法行走的患者可在床边获得一张纸质‘手指迷宫’（finger labyrinth）。

sentences.text: The science behind the theory is a little sketchy, but there are dozens of small-scale studies which support claims about the benefits of labyrinths.
sentences.zh: 支撑该理论的科学依据略显薄弱，但已有数十项小规模研究支持有关迷宫益处的各项主张。

sentences.text: For example, one study found that walking a labyrinth provided ‘short-term calming, relaxation, and relief from anxiety' for Alzheimer's patients.
sentences.zh: 例如，某项研究发现，行走迷宫可为阿尔茨海默病患者带来‘短期的镇静、放松及焦虑缓解’效果。

sentences.text: So, what is it about labyrinths that makes their appeal so universal?
sentences.zh: 那么，究竟是迷宫的什么特质使其吸引力如此普遍？
